description: Scan text or code for leaked secrets: API keys (AWS, GCP, Azure, OpenAI, Anthropic, Stripe, GitHub, GitLab, Slack, Twilio, SendGrid, HuggingFace), Slack / Teams / Discord webhook URLs, private keys, JWTs, database connection strings, Bearer and Basic auth headers, and hard-coded values assigned to password/secret/token names (a value read at run time — Cypress.env(), os.getenv() — is not flagged). Returns findings with type, severity, line and a redacted preview. Regex-based, no network.

input.description: Text to scan — or an array of texts / {id, text} for a batch (one result each, worst gate on top).

types.description: Comma-separated families (default all): aws, gcp, azure, openai, anthropic, huggingface, github, gitlab, stripe, slack, teams, discord, cookie, twilio, sendgrid, jwt, private_key, connection_string, bearer, basic_auth, generic, or pattern names. An unknown value is rejected, never a silent "clean".

name: secret_scan
